themeDescription: Dark store stockouts, item substitutions & inventory sync

challenges.title: Favorite coffee brand went out of stock during active checkout
challenges.shortDescription: Negotiate an agreeable premium replacement for a morning coffee lover whose selection ran out at local micro-fulfillment center.
challenges.mission: Suggest equivalent roast, offer complimentary upgrade difference, or split dispatch from neighboring dark store.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I specifically chose your app because it showed 4 jars of Colombian roast in stock. Right after payment, you texted me saying it's out of stock! My morning is ruined.

guestProfile.personality: particular and irritable without morning coffee

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Reluctant to accept generic chicory blend substitute.
hiddenObjectives: Offer equal or superior single-origin alternative
unacceptablePromises: Do not substitute without customer approval.
